item_name: Rothco Platoon Leader's First Aid Kit
item_short_desc: Be prepared for any outdoor emergency with Rothco's Platoon Leader's First Aid Kit. This comprehensive kit comes packed with over 50 essential first aid items, including bandages, antiseptic wipes, gloves, a cold pack, and more (see product details for the full list). The rugged cotton canvas bag features adjustable straps for versatile carrying as a shoulder or crossbody bag. Compact yet spacious, the bag measures 8 inch x 5 inch x 5 inch, making it easy to store or carry on the go. Its metal buckle closure ensures your supplies remain secure.
